scripts.test:smoke: failed=''; total=0; for test_file in tests/*-smoke.mjs; do total=$((total+1)); node "$test_file" || failed="$failed $test_file"; done; passed=$total; for test_file in $failed; do passed=$((passed-1)); done; echo; echo "Smoke tests: $passed/$total passed"; if [ -n "$failed" ]; then echo 'Failing:'; for test_file in $failed; do echo "  $test_file"; done; exit 1; fi
scripts.test: npm run verify:source && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:smoke
